comment: Myra is the absolute best! She is so nice and helpful. Definitely take her if you want an easy A.

I took Myra for tap--she is so much fun!  Really cool and congenial.  She's so helpful whenever you struggle with dancing.  She plays fun music and clearly has a passion for performing arts.  Academically it is not a hard class but she takes both academics and dancing very seriously.  She loves giving out As!
One of the most down-to-earth, caring, and cool teachers I've had.  Like a hip aunt, not quite motherly but not quite grandmotherly.
